text.zh-CN:
良性前列腺增生可压迫尿道，让排尿开始困难、尿流变弱或夜间频繁起床。

- 前列腺位于膀胱下方，尿道从中穿过。
- 症状通常逐渐出现，严重程度不只看前列腺大小。
- 良性增生不是前列腺癌，但类似症状仍需检查。
text.en:
Benign prostate enlargement can make urination difficult, weak or frequent at night.

- The prostate sits below the bladder around the urethra.
- Symptoms usually develop gradually; gland size is not the only consideration.
- Enlargement is not cancer, but overlapping symptoms still require assessment.

text.zh-CN:
年龄和激素变化可能参与。

- 随着年龄增长更常见，尤其在中老年阶段。
- 家族中有前列腺增生，发生可能性较高。
- 便秘、饮酒或部分药物可加重排尿困扰，不一定代表腺体突然长大。
text.en:
Age and hormonal changes may contribute.

- It becomes more common with ageing.
- Family history increases likelihood.
- Constipation, alcohol or medicines may worsen symptoms without sudden gland growth.

text.zh-CN:
排不出尿需要及时处理。

- 完全不能排尿，尤其伴下腹胀痛，应立即寻求医疗帮助。
- 肉眼血尿或排尿疼痛需要尽快检查。
- 伴发热、明显不适或迅速恶化，不能只增加原来的前列腺药。
text.en:
Inability to pass urine requires prompt care.

- Complete retention, especially with lower abdominal pain, needs immediate help.
- Visible blood or painful urination needs urgent assessment.
- Fever or rapid worsening should not be managed by simply increasing existing medicine.

text.zh-CN:
症状影响生活就可以评估。

- 夜尿影响睡眠、尿急影响出行，或经常觉得排不干净，应预约。
- 漏尿、反复感染或症状持续加重时，需要复查。
- 不必因尴尬延误，排尿问题是常见就诊内容。
text.en:
Seek review when symptoms affect daily life.

- Night waking, urgency or incomplete emptying warrants assessment.
- Leakage, recurrent infection or progression needs review.
- Embarrassment should not delay care for a common problem.

text.zh-CN:
检查既评估排尿，也排除其他原因。

- 可用饮水排尿日记记录频率和量，帮助医生判断。
- 尿检、前列腺指检和必要化验提供不同信息。
- 尿流率或超声可看排尿和残余尿；前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）是一项血液指标，不能单独确诊癌症。
text.en:
Tests assess urination and alternative causes.

- A fluid and bladder diary records frequency and volume.
- Urine tests, a rectal examination of the prostate and selected blood tests provide different information.
- Urine-flow tests or ultrasound assess flow and residual urine; prostate-specific antigen (PSA), a blood marker, does not diagnose cancer by itself.

text.zh-CN:
类似症状不一定都由增生造成。

- 尿路感染可引起尿频、尿急和尿痛。
- 前列腺癌也可能出现重叠表现，因此需按情况排查。
- 膀胱功能或用药问题也可影响排尿，治疗需对应原因。
text.en:
Other conditions can produce similar symptoms.

- UTI can cause frequency, urgency and pain.
- Prostate cancer can have overlapping features and may need investigation.
- Bladder function and medicines can also affect urination.

text.zh-CN:
治疗按照困扰和并发问题选择。

- 轻症可先调整饮水时间、咖啡因和排尿习惯。
- 药物可改善尿流、尿急或减缓腺体增长，作用并不相同。
- 药物效果差或问题严重时，可讨论解除梗阻的手术或其他操作。
text.en:
Treatment follows symptom burden and complications.

- Mild symptoms may respond to changes in fluids, caffeine and habits.
- Medicines target flow, urgency or gland growth differently.
- Persistent severe symptoms may need a procedure to relieve obstruction.

text.zh-CN:
不同药物的获益与风险不同。

- 坦索罗辛等帮助改善尿流，但可引起站起时头晕，影响驾驶或增加跌倒风险。
- 部分药可能改变射精情况，应在治疗前后讨论。
- 减缓前列腺增长的药和缓解尿急的药另有适应情况，不自行叠加。
text.en:
Medicines differ in benefit and risk.

- Tamsulosin can help flow but may cause postural dizziness affecting driving and fall risk.
- Ejaculation changes can occur and deserve discussion.
- Growth-reducing and urgency medicines have different indications and should not be combined unsupervised.

text.zh-CN:
饮食调整主要帮助减轻症状。

- 减少咖啡因和酒精，观察夜尿和尿急是否改善。
- 临睡前少大量饮水，但白天仍应补足适合自己的液体。
- 足够膳食纤维有助减少便秘对膀胱的压力。
text.en:
Dietary changes mainly target symptoms.

- Reduce caffeine and alcohol and observe the effect.
- Avoid large late drinks while maintaining suitable daytime fluids.
- Adequate fibre helps prevent constipation-related bladder pressure.

text.zh-CN:
护理重点是从容排尿和记录。

- 排尿时尽量放松，不反复用力憋压。
- 结束后稍等再试一次，有时有助进一步排空。
- 携带药物清单复诊，核对其他药是否加重排尿困难。
text.en:
Self-care focuses on relaxed emptying and useful records.

- Avoid repeated straining to urinate.
- Waiting briefly and trying again may help emptying.
- Bring a medicine list to check for contributing drugs.

text.zh-CN:
基础情况会改变选择。

- 容易跌倒或正在降压治疗的人，要主动说明头晕风险。
- 合并便秘、膀胱功能异常或多种用药者，需要综合核对。
- 需要导尿者应获得管路护理和何时求助的明确说明。
text.en:
Other circumstances affect treatment choices.

- Mention falls or blood-pressure treatment when discussing dizziness.
- Constipation, bladder dysfunction and multiple medicines need a combined review.
- People needing catheters require clear care and help-seeking instructions.

text.zh-CN:
随访需要看真实排尿效果。

- 记录夜尿、尿流和生活影响，帮助比较治疗前后变化。
- 药物治疗通常需要定期复查效果与副作用。
- 突然不能排尿或血尿时应提前就医，不等常规复诊。
text.en:
Follow-up should assess actual urination.

- Track night waking, flow and daily impact before and after treatment.
- Medicines need regular effectiveness and side-effect review.
- Retention or blood in urine needs earlier care.

text.zh-CN:
排尿受阻可能带来进一步问题。

- 膀胱排不空可造成反复不适并增加感染机会。
- 急性尿潴留是完全不能排尿，可能需要导尿。
- 持续困扰也会影响睡眠和出行，需要及时调整方案。
text.en:
Obstruction can cause further problems.

- Incomplete emptying can cause discomfort and contribute to infection.
- Acute retention may need catheter drainage.
- Persistent symptoms disrupt sleep and travel and justify treatment review.

text.zh-CN:
不能保证阻止年龄相关增生。

- 及时评估排尿变化，避免等到完全排不出才就医。
- 改善便秘、合理安排饮水并减少明显诱因。
- 按约复查药物效果，不相信食物或保健品能保证缩小前列腺。
text.en:
Age-related enlargement cannot always be prevented.

- Assess changes before complete retention occurs.
- Manage constipation, fluids and reproducible triggers.
- Review treatment rather than expecting food or supplements to reliably shrink the gland.

limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.
